Personalized Deposit Recommendation

We built a way to suggest a relevant deposit amount in the cashier flow. The recommendation had to be ready when the customer reached that step.

evoke · 2025

The problem

A model could suggest an amount, but the cashier also had to work for customers across markets and currencies. We needed a design that could handle missing data and keep the payment flow moving if a service was unavailable.

The decision

We calculated recommendations ahead of time in Snowflake. We then copied the results to Redis, where a small service could retrieve them during the payment flow. That moved the heavier work out of the customer’s session.

What we built

I worked through who would own the recommendation data and how the cashier should handle unavailable recommendations. The team built a service that let the cashier fetch a precomputed amount during a deposit.
